title: Communications Officer
description:
Communications Officer
Job Description
About Emergency Nutrition Network (ENN)
Emergency Nutrition Network (ENN) works to reduce undernutrition globally. We enhance the effectiveness of nutrition policy and programming by improving knowledge, stimulating learning and building evidence. We are passionate about being network-driven, independent and evidence-based.
Our vision is that every individual caught up in a nutritional emergency, or suffering from malnutrition anywhere in the world, gets the most effective help possible.
Through our work and collaborations, we support agencies and individuals to implement evidence-based nutrition programming, predominantly in low- and middle-income countries and in fragile and conflict-affected states.
ENN's portfolio includes projects specialising in Infant Feeding in Emergencies, Wasting, Adolescent Nutrition and Management of small & nutritionally At-risk Infants under six months & their Mothers (MAMI), as well as our highly regarded global nutrition publication, Field Exchange.
For more information about ENN's work see our website.
Our People
ENN's team is made up of a range of technical experts in nutrition, with decades of collective experience, and a small, experienced operational team. ENN is highly committed to diversity and inclusion, to enabling and promoting flexible working for our staff, and to supporting continued professional development.
Terms and Conditions
- Hours of work: Full time (37.5 hours per week)
- Type of contract: 12-month fixed term contract, with potential to be made permanent.
- Location: Hybrid or UK-based homeworking with occasional travel to meetings, training events and organisational activities, primarily in Oxford/Oxfordshire. ENN may operate hybrid working arrangements and reserves the right to review working arrangements in the future following consultation. Applicants must have and maintain a valid right to work in the United Kingdom throughout their employment with ENN.
- Holidays: 25 days plus UK public holidays, increasing by one day per annum after two complete years of service to a maximum of 27 days per annum.ENN also provides additional paid office closure days between Christmas and New Year. Pro-rata for part-time staff.
- Pension: Auto-Enrolment to ENN scheme with a generous Employer contribution of 5%.

Additional Benefits includeDental cover, Life cover, Employee Assistance Programme and Wellbeing contribution.
Salary: £28,000 to £29,000 per annum, dependent on experience and suitability for the role.
Purpose of the role and Reporting Lines
The Communications Officer will report to the Communications and Digital Manager. The role works closely with our Project Managers, and technical project leads. The Communications Officer will facilitate effective and engaging communications across the organisation (internal and external) with particular emphasis on enabling effective communication of our project's work/outputs, demonstrating impact, and enhancing dissemination to a wider and more diverse audience.
We are looking for someone with a passion for translating technical nutrition/public health content and communicating it to a broad array of stakeholders, ensuring it is widely accessible, to drive effective and positive change in nutrition policy, practice and research at global, regional and national levels.
Key Responsibilities:
Support the Communications and Digital Manager in executing ENN's communication strategies (both internal and external) by:
Project Communications, Publication and Dissemination
Plan and execute a communication and dissemination plan for each project/output, working alongside the technical project lead, project manager and communication and digital manager, within budget/resourcing.
Produce an array of professional dissemination resources (e.g. social media content, brochures, posters, visual abstracts etc) to effectively communicate our work to different audiences (both technical and non-technical)
Create engaging visual multimedia content for use on ENN websites, social media channels and online events, under the support and direction of the Communications and Digital Manager.
Manage an image bank, ensuring that it is refreshed, and that all imagery has been appropriately licensed/credited. Identifying suitable imagery for use in various contexts.
Support with procurement, coordination and briefing of copyeditors, designers, videographers, translators, printers and other external communication service providers as needed. Review and check proofs and coordinate feedback/revisions.
Assist with the production and dissemination of ENN's flagship publication Field Exchange (both print and digital in English and French).
Set up and administer online meetings, launch webinars, and in-person dissemination events e.g., conference side events etc.
Create and administer surveys seeking feedback on our work including collation and formatting of results.
Website and social media
Online content production and day-to-day updating and uploading of content on ENN's website, and YouTube channel.
Manage social media campaigns for projects/outputs/events, including drafting and posting content across platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp Community, en-net forum)
Plan and manage a social media calendar, scheduling posts and aligning content with relevant days/upcoming events in the sector relevant to ENN's work.
Support with delivering training/instruction, producing guidance, for staff on use of social media, comms/website, AI etc.
Maintain the CRM system (network signups through the website), and communication to our networks via newsletters, ensuring that data protection procedures are adhered to.
Communication Monitoring and Analysis
Monitor and analyse communications data and produce reports to improve performance and grow our audience and reach
Ensure that monitoring sources (including Google Analytics/DOIs) are up to date and collection of website monitoring data is functioning properly.
Support with data visualisation
Digital Fundraising
Undertake research on potential funding opportunities/sources, and support with developing funding proposal with a focus on digital fundraising
Person Specification Essential
Knowledge or strong interest in communication in nutrition, global public health, and / or the humanitarian/development sector.
Excellent communication (in both English and French): writing, editing, presenting and proof-reading skills; the ability to write content for websites/social media including adapting technical language and content to appeal to a wide and diverse audience.
Experience producing high-quality communication and dissemination products using a variety of digital tools/software.
Creative vision to help develop appealing content that is accessible, with an eye for detail and design. Able to innovate and problem-solve. Open to learn new skills.
Experience in organising high level dissemination events e.g. launch webinars/ conference events, online and in-person.
Strong organisational skills, with experience of prioritising a varied workload and meeting deadlines using own initiative and with minimal supervision.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to consolidate data and information with a high degree of accuracy.
Strong interpersonal skills, able to work both autonomously and as a member of a dispersed and diverse team.
Good cross-cultural communication skills with an understanding of, and commitment to, equal opportunities and diversity.
Experience in creating /uploading website content and working with online content management systems.
Proficiency with mainstream social media platforms (e.g., YouTube, Threads, LinkedIn, Instagram) and experience using social media effectively for business purposes.
Ability to use Adobe Suite, Canva and video/podcast editing software e.g. Riverside.
Strong technical skills including fluency in Microsoft Office
Desirable
Practical experience in web design and functionality
Experience in filming interviews/producing podcasts
Experience working with CRMs web and email management platforms (e.g., Brevo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Drupal, Mailchimp)
Experience with Google Analytics and/or other website data analytics and data visualisation tools.
Other Language skills (e.g. Spanish, Arabic) are not essential but will be a plus as we also produce content in these languages
Eligibility to work:
The successful applicant will be required to demonstrate that they have and can maintain the Right to Work in the United Kingdom throughout their employment with ENN. This includes evidencing a UK National Insurance number and UK tax residency. A Certificate of Sponsorship, visa sponsorship and relocation package are not available for this position.
ENN is committed to diversity and inclusion, and to building a culture where every staff member and volunteer is recognised and valued as an individual. We actively encourage applications from a broad range of experiences and backgrounds.
Application Process
Please submit a Cover Letter (no more than 1 page) and CV no later than 23:59 on Tursday 1 October 2026.

title: Email Campaign Executive
description:
Ready to make your mark in digital marketing?

If you love getting stuck into email campaigns, spotting what makes a subject line work, and turning data into decisions, this could be your next big move.

An exciting opportunity has opened up for an Email Campaign Executive to join a well-established manufacturer in the safety equipment sector, based in Oxfordshire. This is a genuinely international business, and this role puts you right at the centre of how they communicate with their global distribution network.

You'll take ownership of email marketing campaigns from planning through to reporting, working closely with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across multiple regions. It's a role with real variety, real responsibility, and real opportunity to grow.

On offer is a salary of £27,000 plus a bonus of up to £2,000 a year, paid quarterly based on sales targets. You'll also get 25 days holiday, an employer-matched pension, a personal development plan, Perkbox discounts, a wellbeing programme, and a cycle-to-work scheme. The role is office-based (with WFH one day a week once you're through probation), so you'll need your own transport to get there.

Key Responsibilities:
- Plan, build and send email campaigns for the company's global distribution network
- Manage a global campaign calendar so every send lands on time
- Build targeted campaigns around customer needs and business goals
- Create and manage automated journeys, nurture campaigns and lead generation
- Work closely with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across different regions
- Keep the marketing database clean and GDPR-compliant
- Run A/B tests to keep improving campaign performance
- Track KPIs and turn the numbers into clear, actionable insight
- Make sure every campaign matches company brand guidelines and technical accuracy
- Support event promotion and follow-up lead nurturing
- Spot opportunities to improve automation, reporting and campaign efficiency

Skills & Experience:
- 2+ years' experience in email marketing, campaign management or marketing automation
- Experience in a B2 B marketing environment
- Confident with CRM systems and customer data
- Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms and automation tools
- Comfortable analysing performance data and turning it into recommendations
- Experience building campaign reports and dashboards
- Sharp attention to detail and solid project management skills
- Strong written communication and copywriting ability
- Able to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines at once
- A team player who's used to working across marketing, sales and product
- Bonus points for experience with international markets or multi-language campaigns

How to Apply:

This is a genuine chance to grow your marketing career inside an established, international manufacturer, with training, support and real ownership from day one. If you're re ady to take the next step, apply now or contact Niche Recruitment with any questions.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Oxfordshire

£30-40k

VR/10568

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a skilled Marketing Executive to join a successful and well-established company based in Oxfordshire, who are part of a large international group. They are now embarking on an exciting phase of growth and this is a new role to help increase their impact and reach.

This role is perfect for an all round marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building from the ground up.

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the Marketing Executive will primarily focus on D2 C and B2 B funnels optimisation. Your work will directly contribute to brand awareness, lead generation, and revenue growth.

Your role will involve:
- Brand - Keep consistency within the company's core brand values, tone, and visual identity across all customer-facing assets (website, social media, email, print, etc.).
- Campaigns and Email Marketing - Develop, execute, and optimise multi-channel campaigns (email, social, paid, organic) to drive conversion.
- A/B test subject lines, CTAs, and content to refine performance.
- SEO, Content and Design - Create and optimise landing pages, blog posts,and marketing collateral.
- Conduct keyword research and implement on-page SEO best practices (meta tags, headers, internal linking) to improve organic search rankings.
- Design on marketing materials (social posts,brochures, presentations) using brand guidelines
- Social media - Manage and grow the company's presence on LinkedIn (B2 B) and Instagram (D2 C and B2 B), tailoring content for each audience.
- Events - Coordinate with event partners to ensure seamless execution of conferences and planned activities
- CRM - Maintain data hygiene in the CRM (e.g., deduplication, missing information, tagging)
- Performance Marketing - Collect, visualise, and interpret performance data to inform decisions.

You will be the ideal candidate due to your:
- Previous marketing experience in B2 C and/or B2 B.
- Marketing generalist mindset: Comfortable wearing multiple hats and adapting to evolving priorities
- Strong content marketing and storytelling skills: Ability to craft SEO-optimised narratives for diverse audiences.
- Data-driven decision-making: Proficient in analysing metrics (GA4, CRM reports and more) to optimise campaigns.
- Proactive and autonomous.
- Growth mindset: Curious, resourceful, and always seeking to learn and improve.
- Hands-on CRM experience.

Desirable
- HubSpot knowledge and/or certification
- Canva or designing tools (Adobe Suite, Figma)
- Brevo or other email marketing tools
- E-commerce platform i.e Shopify
- SEO/SEM knowledge: Basic understanding of technical SEO, backlinking, and paid search strategies
- Project Management: Ability to juggle multiple deadlines.

title: Temporary Marketing Account Manager
description:
Are you an experienced marketing professional looking for a temporary role where you can make an immediate impact? This is an exciting opportunity to support a leading organisation within the horticulture sector during a busy period, helping coordinate key events and campaigns with minimal onboarding.

Please note, this is a temporary position paid on a weekly PAYE basis and will require an immediate start, notice periods cannot be accommodated.

Temporary Marketing Account Manager Responsibilities
This position will involve, but will not be limited to:
- Managing multiple marketing projects, ensuring deadlines are met and outputs are delivered to a high standard.
- Planning and delivering materials for high-profile events, including content capture and event support during the conferences and awards.
- Liaising with printers and suppliers to produce print materials, ensuring specifications are met and proofreading is accurate.
- Supporting social media and content creation during events, including live posting and capturing vox pops.
- Coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders to maintain project momentum.
- Assisting with email marketing campaigns and CRM management to support event promotion.
- Attending events and visits as required, supporting logistical and operational needs.

Temporary Marketing Account Manager Rewards
- Flexibility to work from home 2 days a week once trained
- Opportunities to support major events
- Occasional travel for events

The Company
Our client's culture is built on teamwork, inclusion, and trust, with a focus on innovation and member support. This is a fantastic environment for someone looking to gain valuable event and project management experience.

Temporary Marketing Project Executive/Manager Experience Essentials
- Proven experience in managing marketing projects, ideally within an agency, events, or marketing operations setting.
- Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
- Excellent communication and proofreading skills, particularly with print materials.
- Experience supporting social media during events and creating engaging content in real time.
- Familiarity with email automation and CRM platforms.
- Confidence liaising directly with printers and suppliers.
- Calm under pressure and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
- Valid driver s licence and access to own vehicle, as travel expenses will be reimbursed.

Location
Based in Didcot with regular presence in the office at least three days a week. Transport links are limited, so own transport is essential. There is onsite parking available. Occasional travel to events and sites will be required; all travel costs will be reimbursed.

Action
If you would like to find out more about this excellent opportunity, then please apply online today. We will review and respond to all applications.
